metadata.title: Moderna Is Yesterday's Top Gainer and Today's Biggest Loser

content.text:
CONCLUDED
3 hours ago
What goes up, must come down.
Moderna was the best performing stock in the S&P 500 yesterday. Today, it's the index's biggest laggard.
Moderna stock had fallen over 22% on Thursday in its worst single-day decline on record, according to Dow Jones Market Data. The stock more than doubled in the trading session prior. It was the first time an S&P 500 component doubled in one day since 2008.
